operations-support: The HR inbox needs a reliable daily owner.

An employee asks whether a signed policy form has been received. The assistant checks the approved record, updates the request status and follows up on missing paperwork. A question about how the policy applies is routed to the HR lead.
A current request tracker, linked documents and a short list of decisions waiting on the HR owner.
customer-support: Employees need answers without losing requests in email.

An employee cannot find an enrollment form. The assistant sends the approved resource and confirms the request is complete. If the employee asks which plan to choose, the question moves to the benefits specialist.
An answered routine request, a recorded resolution and a clear escalation for advice.
admin-support: Interview coordination is taking time away from recruiting.
A hiring manager changes availability after an interview is booked. The assistant checks approved alternatives, coordinates with the candidate and updates the calendar and applicant record together.
A confirmed interview, consistent calendar details and a current recruiting status.
reporting-and-qa: The weekly people report contains conflicting numbers.
The assistant compares the approved HRIS export with the report checklist, identifies missing fields and flags mismatched totals. The HR owner confirms the correction before the report is circulated.
A checked draft, source references and an exception list that explains unresolved differences.
candidate-sourcing: A new requisition needs a researched candidate list.

The recruiter provides objective requirements and approved search sources. The assistant records evidence against those requirements, removes duplicates and marks missing information for review instead of assuming a match.
A source-linked longlist with consistent fields for the recruiter to assess.
interview-coordination: A panel interview spans several calendars.

The assistant gathers availability, checks time zones, sends approved invitations and monitors confirmations. When a panel member cancels, the recruiter receives viable alternatives and the candidate receives an approved update.
Confirmed invitations, current applicant status and tracked scorecard follow-up.
employee-records-administration: An approved employee change needs consistent records.

The assistant checks the authorized change request against required fields, prepares updates in the approved system and records discrepancies. Conflicting effective dates are returned to the HR owner before any change is finalized.
A traceable change record with source authorization and unresolved discrepancies clearly flagged.
benefits-administration-support: The assistant checks the packet against the approved checklist, requests the missing fields and tracks the deadline. Eligibility questions and exceptions go to the benefits owner before the carrier handoff.
A completeness tracker and review-ready packet, with advice and eligibility decisions kept separate.
payroll-preparation-support: Payroll inputs need review before the cutoff.

The assistant compares approved time and change records, highlights missing approvals and prepares a reconciliation note. The payroll owner resolves exceptions and authorizes the run; the assistant does not release funds.
Organized inputs, documented differences and evidence of the payroll owner's review.
onboarding-coordination: A new hire starts next week.

The assistant tracks forms, equipment requests and meeting invitations across HR, IT and the manager. Missing items are chased before the start date, while each team retains its own access and approval decisions.
A current onboarding checklist showing completed tasks, blockers and responsible owners.
learning-administration: Required training needs accurate completion records.
The assistant checks the approved roster, sends reminders and reconciles learning-system completions. A mismatch between assigned and completed course versions is flagged to the learning owner.
A reconciled roster, completion evidence and an exception list for follow-up.
hr-help-desk-support: Routine and sensitive requests arrive in the same queue.

The assistant tags each request and answers documented questions using approved guidance. A message about a grievance or medical issue is routed through the confidential escalation process without attempting to resolve it.
A triaged queue with response history and appropriate confidential handoffs.
performance-review-administration: Managers are approaching a review deadline.

The assistant checks the eligible roster, tracks missing forms and sends approved reminders. Review ratings and evaluation text remain unchanged; disputed or incomplete submissions go to the cycle owner.
An accurate completion report and a list of overdue actions by manager.
offboarding-coordination: An authorized departure needs a coordinated handoff.

After HR approves the event, the assistant tracks equipment return, system-removal requests and required documents. Payroll and IT confirm their own actions; the assistant flags missing evidence before the checklist closes.
A departure checklist with owner confirmations, outstanding items and retained records.
